description: This file contains utility functions for React component manipulation, column metadata management, and fetching datasource schema information in a Superset frontend project. It defines interfaces, React cloning functions, column update logic, and an API call to sync columns with the database schema.

methods.name: recurseReactClone
methods.description: Recursively clones React children, injecting props into components matching a specified type.

methods.name: updateColumns
methods.description: Compares previous and new column metadata, determines added, modified, and removed columns, updates final columns, and shows success toasts.

methods.name: fetchSyncedColumns
methods.description: Fetches column metadata from a datasource's underlying table/view to synchronize schema.
